Food from Ukraine · Gaza programme

From Ukrainian fields to people in need in Gaza.

Everyone deserves enough good food. Together with Ukrainian farmers and our partners in the region, we bring familiar, nourishing food to people in Gaza, with care and full transparency.

The need

Why food assistance is needed in Gaza

Most people in Gaza cannot currently grow, buy or access enough food and safe water on their own, and remain dependent on humanitarian aid.

Photos: GEM MENA, our partner in the region

    The model

    One food kit, two communities

    Food aid should help the people who receive it and the community that produces it. Every kit from Ukraine does both.

    Spend once, and it works twice.

    Spend once,
    ONE KIT
    01 · UKRAINE

    Farms and factories keep working

    Flour, groats, oil and tinned food come from 87 small and medium farms and 11 factories that are members of the consortium. Wages and jobs stay with the producers, and taxes go to the state budget of Ukraine.

    and it works twice.
    02 · GAZA

    People in need receive a balanced kit

    The same kit is designed around what people actually eat and handed to a partner who distributes it on the ground.

    How it works

    Seven steps from the field to the people in need

    1. Growing

      87 small and medium Ukrainian farms grow grain and raw materials.

    2. Production

      11 factories that are members of the consortium make flour, groats, pasta, oil and tinned food.

    3. To the port

      Containers travel by road to the port of Constanța, Romania.

    4. By sea to Dubai

      Vessels carry the containers through the Suez Canal and the Red Sea to Jebel Ali, Dubai.

    5. Kit packing in Dubai

      At the RIDNE hub in Dubai Humanitarian, food is checked and packed into kits: a standard kit or one built to a partner's ration, with the donor's logo if needed.

    6. Overland through Jordan

      Kits travel by road through Jordan to a receiving partner in Gaza.

    7. Tracking and reporting

      Every pallet and carton is tagged at source and scanned at each step. Partners receive a full report on what was delivered.
